findings.label: Bare fragment wrappers in tbody
findings.description: AdminFAQsPage.tsx (line 132) and AdminMasterProgramsPage.tsx (line 134) use bare <> fragments as direct tbody children inside .map(). React requires keyed <React.Fragment key={...}> here. Replace <> with <React.Fragment key={faq.id}> and <React.Fragment key={mp.id}> respectively.
